features.description: Establish a Go-enabled, clean, discriminating execution baseline before edits.
acceptance_criteria: Go is available and relevant package baselines have an informative result.
Every red-at-base command is recorded exactly and excluded only with user approval.
No unrelated working-tree changes are overwritten.
features.notes: Planning workspace did not contain go; executor must establish this baseline.

features.description: Implement the executor-local transcript recorder, optional per-turn usage, pi wiring, and mutation-tested caps.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic five-turn replay proves role order, block order, event forwarding, usage, and defensive snapshots.
Pi fixtures prove output/reasoning disjointness, zero usage when absent, and non-empty Result.Transcript.
A 456-turn replay stays bounded and each tool result is at most the 8192-byte cap including marker.
Changing only maxToolResultBytes from 8192 to 16384 compiles and makes the named cap test fail; restoring 8192 makes it pass.
Relevant executor/pi tests, formatting, and vet pass.

features.description: Add migrate_v22 and one lossless Backend.PutChatMessages path used by SQLite, Firestore, motoko, and claudehistory.
acceptance_criteria: v21-to-v22 and fresh-schema tests round-trip reason_tokens and default old rows to zero.
SQLite replay is idempotent and task/session reads preserve every rich content, correlation, and usage field.
Firestore tests prove deterministic IDs, expire_at, full field mapping, and surfaced write errors.
Motoko and claudehistory fixtures are field-equivalent before and after migration to PutChatMessages.
No non-test importer contains a direct INSERT INTO chat_messages.
SQLite and Firestore compile-time assertions satisfy Backend.
features.notes: D5 is binding: migration is in-sprint and must preserve content_text, content_thinking, request_id, and stage_id.

features.description: Persist local and Cloud Run turns, with the verified job-SA Firestore grant as the first and blocking M3 task.
acceptance_criteria: O1 evidence names the service account, terraform grant, applied revision, and effective policy result before any M3 cloud-code change.
Repeated local finalize produces one logical row per deterministic message ID.
A completed cloud turn is written immediately and remains after later cancellation; write errors are observable.
Observatory project selection is explicit and has no ambient-project fallback.
A 30-day TTL policy targets obs_chat_messages.expire_at.
features.notes: D1 is fixed to direct Firestore writes. If O1 cannot be verified/applied, M3 blocks; do not switch transport.

features.description: Run local/cloud acceptance, cancellation durability, token accounting, and reconcile stale design-doc scope text.
acceptance_criteria: Local and cloud pi runs are readable through chains chat with ordered blocks and non-zero usage.
A cancelled cloud job retains every turn completed before cancellation.
Sum of tokens_out plus reason_tokens equals Result.OutputTokens for the acceptance run.
The design doc no longer defers D5 and consistently records the ratified 1.5-day scope.
All touched-package tests, vet, formatting, boundaries, and informative build gates pass.

execution_instruction: Mark must approve this plan and explicitly say execute sprint before sprint-executor starts.
